name: Text
summary: Body and supporting text in one of the composite text styles. Not for headings (use Heading) or text inside a control (the control owns its label).
a11y: Plain text element; inherits language and direction. Tone is never the only carrier of meaning.

props.name: variant
props.description: Composite text style. `lead` (IP11): body-scale prose a step up, for a paragraph that opens or sums up what follows. `statement`: one display-scale sentence that isn't a heading (a mission, facts read as a sentence), at most one per view. `inherit` (IP22): the size, face and weight of the text around it, for a span inside a heading or another text (an accent phrase); use it with `as="span"`.

props.name: tone
props.description: Colour by meaning. A status tone needs words that carry the status too, never colour alone. `accent` (IP22): brand-coloured words that aren't a link (an emphasised phrase), on the accent text role, or the accent display role inside a large heading or a statement; never the only carrier of meaning.

props.name: as
props.description: `p` for a paragraph, `span` inside other text or controls.

props.name: id
props.description: Lets another element take its name from this text (`aria-labelledby`).

props.name: weight
props.description: `strong`: semibold, for a short label that leads a group (a group heading in a results list) without being a heading. `regular`: the regular weight, for a quieter part inside strong text (a count after it). Left out, the variant's own weight.
